import sys, json, copy
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from tlib import run, check_neg_cycle

# ---- inconsistent profile across ops
prof_bad = {"groups":2,"jitter_ps":[0,0],"measurements":[[0,1,2,4],[0,1,5,6]]}
fab = {"n":2,"interval_ns":1,"slice_ns":8,"offset_ns":0,"drift_ppb":[0,0],
       "heat":[],"anchors":[[0,0,8]],"links":[
         {"ends":[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]],"delay_ns":[1,1],"defer_rounds":[0,0]}],
       "slices":[[0]],"blackouts":[],"guards_ns":[0],"reconfig_ns":0}
trace = {"rounds":2,"rates_ppb":[[0,0],[0,0]],"bias_ps":[0,0],"sends":[],
         "lost":[],"reboots":[],"queries":[2]}
r = run([{"op":"calibrate","profile":prof_bad},
         {"op":"plan","profile":prof_bad,"fabric":fab},
         {"op":"replay","profile":prof_bad,"fabric":fab,"guard_ns":0,"trace":trace}])
for res in r:
    assert res['status']=='inconsistent', res
    assert check_neg_cycle(prof_bad, res['cycle']), res
print('inconsistent ops ok')

# audit: valid inconsistency proof accepted, forged ones rejected
proof = r[0]
[a1] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_bad,"fabric":fab,"proposal":proof}])
assert a1=={"valid":True}, a1
for bad in [{"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[]},
            {"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[0,1]},
            {"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[0,2]},
            {"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[5]},
            {"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[-1]},
            {"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[0,3,0,3]},
            {"status":"inconsistent","cycle":[3,0]}]:
    [a2] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_bad,"fabric":fab,"proposal":bad}])
    assert a2=={"valid":False}, (bad,a2)
# consistent profile cannot prove inconsistency
prof_ok = {"groups":1,"jitter_ps":[0],"measurements":[]}
[a3] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab,"proposal":proof}])
assert a3=={"valid":False}, a3
print('inconsistency audit ok')

# ---- plan on inconsistent profile returns the inconsistency shape
[p1] = run([{"op":"plan","profile":prof_bad,"fabric":fab}])
assert p1['status']=='inconsistent', p1
# a plan-shaped proposal on an inconsistent profile is invalid
plan_shaped = {"status":"ok","profile":proof,"period_rounds":8,"peaks_as":[0],
               "guard_ns":0,"bounds_as":None,"age_rounds":None,"pred":None,
               "warmup_cycle":None}
[a4] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_bad,"fabric":fab,"proposal":plan_shaped}])
assert a4=={"valid":False}, a4
print('plan on inconsistent ok')

# ---- fabric with no anchors: everything unknown / null
fab_noa = dict(fab, anchors=[])
[p2] = run([{"op":"plan","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab_noa}])
assert p2['status']=='ok' and p2['guard_ns'] is None, p2
assert p2['peaks_as']==[None], p2
assert p2['bounds_as'] is None and p2['age_rounds'] is None and p2['pred'] is None
assert p2['warmup_cycle'] is None
[a5] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab_noa,"proposal":p2}])
assert a5=={"valid":True}, a5
# claiming values must fail
p2b = copy.deepcopy(p2)
p2b['warmup_cycle'] = 0
[a6] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab_noa,"proposal":p2b}])
assert a6=={"valid":False}, a6
p2c = copy.deepcopy(p2)
p2c['guard_ns'] = 0
[a7] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab_noa,"proposal":p2c}])
assert a7=={"valid":False}, a7
print('no-anchor fabric ok')

# ---- big drift so that no guard is safe (guard < peak + reconfig)
fab_hot = dict(fab, anchors=[[0,0,8],[1,0,8]], drift_ppb=[2000,2000], guards_ns=[0,1])
[p3] = run([{"op":"plan","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab_hot}])
# drift 2000ppb * T=1ns = 2000 as peak = 2000; g=1ns = 1e9 as >= 2000 + 0 -> safe actually
assert p3['guard_ns']==0, p3
fab_hot2 = dict(fab, anchors=[[0,0,8]], drift_ppb=[2000000,2000000],
                guards_ns=[0], reconfig_ns=5)
[p4] = run([{"op":"plan","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab_hot2}])
# peak = bound(0)+2e6*1 = 2e6 as; g=0 cannot cover 2e6 + 5e9 -> no safe guard
assert p4['guard_ns'] is None and p4['bounds_as'] is None, p4
[a8] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab_hot2,"proposal":p4}])
assert a8=={"valid":True}, a8
print('no-safe-guard ok')

# ---- out-of-range ids in proposals
p = run([{"op":"plan","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab}])[0]
assert p['status']=='ok'
m = copy.deepcopy(p)
m['profile']['pred']=[[None]]
m['profile']['pred'][0][0]=99
m['profile']['upper_ps']=[[0]]
[a9] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab,"proposal":m}])
assert a9=={"valid":False}, a9
m = copy.deepcopy(p)
if m['pred'] and m['pred'][0] and m['pred'][0][0] is not None:
    m['pred'][0][0][1] = 99
    [a10] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab,"proposal":m}])
    assert a10=={"valid":False}, a10
# wrong period
m = copy.deepcopy(p); m['period_rounds']=1
[a11] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof_ok,"fabric":fab,"proposal":m}])
assert a11=={"valid":False}, a11
# bad calibration pred cycle
prof3 = {"groups":3,"jitter_ps":[0,0,0],"measurements":[[0,1,0,2],[1,2,0,2],[0,2,0,4]]}
p3 = run([{"op":"plan","profile":prof3,"fabric":fab}])[0]
assert p3['status']=='ok'
m = copy.deepcopy(p3)
m['profile']['pred'][0][1] = 1   # constraint 1 ends at 0, not at 1 -> invalid
[a12] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof3,"fabric":fab,"proposal":m}])
assert a12=={"valid":False}, a12
m = copy.deepcopy(p3)
m['profile']['upper_ps'][0][2] = 5   # infeasible row (0,5) violates [0,4]
[a13] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof3,"fabric":fab,"proposal":m}])
assert a13=={"valid":False}, a13
# non-integer cells
m = copy.deepcopy(p3)
m['peaks_as'][0] = True
[a14] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof3,"fabric":fab,"proposal":m}])
assert a14=={"valid":False}, a14
m = copy.deepcopy(p3)
m['profile']['upper_ps'][0][1] = 2.0
[a15] = run([{"op":"audit","profile":prof3,"fabric":fab,"proposal":m}])
assert a15=={"valid":False}, a15
print('bad-proposal rejection ok')
print('edge tests all OK')
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 test_edge.py
